scripts.web: npm run build:shared && node scripts/run.mjs concurrently -k -n api,mcp,web -c blue,magenta,green "cross-env PORT=4000 npm run start:dev -w @wpconnect/api" "cross-env PORT=4100 npm run dev -w @wpconnect/mcp" "npm run dev -w @wpconnect/web"
scripts.db:push: node scripts/run.mjs prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @wpconnect/api && npm run build -w @wpconnect/mcp && npm run build -w @wpconnect/web
